metadata.description: REMY — the coaching layer for AI coding agents. He watches you drive, and tells you what it cost.

plugins.name: remy
plugins.description: In-agent coaching for Claude Code: a live statusline (context, prompt-cache clock, cost, git), deterministic waste detection, and tips that name the file, the fix, and what it costs you. Metadata-only and local — no account, no server, nothing you do is ever uploaded; the only network traffic is a payload-free daily ping that counts active installs (opt-out).
